# Server Rules Rule 1- Don't be a dick- We're all here to have a good time, so act in good faith.
Rule 2- Don't cheat/use exploits/use Metacomms/ or any other nongrasstouching behavior.
Rule 3- Do not ERP- This is an 18 plus community, that doesn't mean you can be a freak. Stop that.
Rule 4- Keep IC information out of OOC and OOC out of IC information. That includes internet speak
Rule 5- Dying is part of the game, Losing is also part of the game. Don't be a sore loser.
Rule 6- A little bit of greytiding is fine but don't constantly greytide or validhunt. You can defend yourself, and antagonists have more leeway with this rule.
Rule 7- Admins have the final say - We're all just people here and we're all reasonable.
Rule 8- Don't threaten to, or joke about DOXing or SWATTing anyone, that's an instant unappealable ban.
